title: Dissipation and c-Entropy in Nevanlinna-Pick Interpolation
summary: We study interpolation L-systems realizing finite Nevanlinna-Pick data sets and analyze their structural and quantitative characteristics. Explicit formulas are derived for the c-entropy and dissipation coefficient, two intrinsic invariants that describe the dissipative structure of interpolation L-systems. These quantities depend only on the geometric placement of interpolation nodes in $\mathbb{C}_+$, attaining maximal finite values for purely imaginary nodes.
